name: redmaterials
description: Bootstrap theme inspired by Google Material Design and various projects

scripts.build:css: lessc --source-map less/redmaterials.less dist/css/redmaterials.css && postcss dist/css/redmaterials.css --use autoprefixer -o dist/css/redmaterials.css --map
scripts.build:docs:css: lessc --source-map docs/assets/css/docs.less docs/assets/css/docs.css && postcss docs/assets/css/docs.css --use autoprefixer -o docs/assets/css/docs.css --map && cleancss -o docs/assets/css/docs.min.css docs/assets/css/docs.css
scripts.build:docs:copy: cp -r dist/css docs/dist/ && cp -r dist/js docs/dist/
scripts.build:docs: npm run build:docs:css && npm run build:docs:js && npm run build:docs:copy && npm run build:fonts
scripts.dist: npm run clean && mkdir -p dist/css dist/js dist/fonts && npm run build:css && npm run build:css:min && npm run build:js
scripts.build: npm run dist && npm run docs
scripts.watch: npm run dist -- && nodemon --watch less --ext less --exec 'npm run dist'

author: Redooor LLP
